summary.en: The October unconsolidated pipeline highlights only two drug programs, led by Phase 3 larsucosterol. Aesthetic-device development sits alongside this narrow pharmaceutical pipeline.
summary.zh: 10 月的非合并管线仅重点列出两个药物项目,以 III 期 larsucosterol 为首。医美器械开发与这条较窄的制药管线并行。

ind.zh: 轻至中度溃疡性结肠炎

watch.en: Only larsucosterol and amiselimod are highlighted as pharmaceutical clinical programs.
watch.zh: 仅 larsucosterol 和 amiselimod 被列为重点药物临床项目。

watch.en: Amiselimod remains under internal opportunity review.
watch.zh: Amiselimod 仍处于内部机会评估中。

watch.en: Bausch reported more than $500m net debt reduction in Q3, excluding Bausch + Lomb.
watch.zh: Bausch 报告第三季度净债务减少超过 $500m(不含 Bausch + Lomb)。

watch.en: The pipeline document flags negotiated Xifaxan prices becoming effective in 2027.
watch.zh: 管线文件指出,Xifaxan 的谈判价格将于 2027 年生效。

sources: Salix amiselimod license from Mitsubishi Tanabe, April 25, 2019
gaps: This is the unconsolidated Bausch Health pharmaceutical pipeline, as explicitly labeled in the October document; Bausch + Lomb’s separate eye-health pipeline is not merged into it.
The company highlights two pharmaceutical programs, so the thin list is intentional. Aesthetic devices are excluded because their development stages do not map to drug Phases 1–3.
Amiselimod is retained at Phase 2 based on its completed development bar and opportunity-review status, not treated as an initiated Phase 3 program. The illustrative bar is not milestone guidance.
Counts is null: no company-published counts by phase were verified.
Larsucosterol acquired origin is documented in the Q1 2026 filing, which is older than 2026-06; current Phase 3 status comes from October 2026.

No company-guided future drug milestone/date was verified. Amiselimod modality remains null; larsucosterol code remains unverified. The 2019 license and March 2025 DURECT filing predate 2026-06 and support provenance/mechanism only.
